fact: On 15 January 2024 the communications minister said a project to automate local administration and governorate offices had begun with the Ministry of Local Development, with Minya as the pilot, its governorate office to be linked electronically to the markaz and local units during 2024 before the rest of the country, over the fibre network linking 32,000 government buildings.
title: وزير الاتصالات لـ"الدستور": بدء تنفيذ مشروع قومى لميكنة المحليات.. والبداية من المنيا
